items.q: On November 5, 2024, the voters of South Carolina made their choice for President and Vice President overwhelmingly clear.  I am proud to certify today’s Electoral College vote

record.t: Convened the 2024 Electoral College in Columbia on December 17, 2024.
record.q: Secretary of State Mark Hammond convened the 2024 Electoral College on Tuesday, December 17, 2024 at 11:00 AM in Columbia, South Carolina.

record.t: Was returned to office as Secretary of State by voters in 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022.
record.q: Voters returned Secretary Hammond to office in 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018 and most recently in 2022.

record.t: Was elected as South Carolina's 41st Secretary of State on November 5, 2002.
record.q: On November 5th, 2002, he was elected as South Carolina's 41st Secretary of State.

record.t: Served as Spartanburg County's Clerk of Court from 1997 to 2002.
record.q: Mark Hammond served as Spartanburg County's Clerk of Court from 1997 to 2002.

record.t: Worked as a Criminal Investigator aiding prosecutors for the 7th Circuit Solicitor's Office until 1996.
record.q: worked as a Criminal Investigator, aiding prosecutors for the 7th Circuit Solicitor’s Office, until 1996.

record.t: Launched Give Smart SC, a free app for looking up registered charities, reviewing their financial information and filing complaints with the Secretary of State.
record.q: Launching Give Smart SC, a free app that allows donors to look up charities registered to solicit in South Carolina, review their financial information, and file complaints with the Secretary of State
